projectDescription: Cyberwave is a cloud-based robotics platform that lets developers connect physical robots and sensors, build AI-powered automations using digital twins, and deploy ML models to the edge or cloud — all through a unified Python SDK and CLI.
keyFeatures: Connect 90+ robots and sensors using a single unified SDK
Digital twin simulation in browser (Playground) and full-fidelity MuJoCo
Swap between human, code, and AI controllers at runtime
100+ pre-built AI model catalog (vision, VLA, pose, segmentation)
Automatic data collection and dataset management in open formats (LeRobot, parquet)
Edge and cloud model inference with no infrastructure management
GDPR-ready built-in anonymisation for recorded data
CLI for pairing and managing physical hardware
publicApiSurface: cw.twin(robot_id) — get or create a digital twin
cw.affect('simulation' | 'live') — toggle simulation vs live mode
twin.use_controller(controller_name) — assign a controller to a twin
cw.models.load(model_name) — load a model from catalog or your own checkpoint
cw.datasets.add(path) — register a dataset for training or visualisation
cyberwave pair — CLI command to pair physical hardware
CYBERWAVE_ENVIRONMENT_ID — environment variable for multi-environment setups
